summary: Can the PARKED WY (chunked Householder) GDN tree kernel break through if re-judged at the B=4-CUDA-temp0.6 ARGMAX-LOSSLESS-WITHIN-FLOOR bar (NOT the byte-exact-0.0 bar it failed on)? WY removes the 9x HBM state tax (the per-forward speed lever). Mine the archived WY branch + judge B=4 dispatch/batch-invariance/capture viability. CPU, no GPU.

synthesis.wy_failed_wrong_bar: YES, decisively. WY was abandoned at the literal-0.0 byte-exact bar (which it can never meet), not the within-floor argmax bar. Native verify is the SEQUENTIAL rank-1 fused-sigmoid-gating-delta-rule-update at gdn linear attn line 1119; the chunked path at lines 1142 and 1148 is guarded by num-prefills greater than 0, so it is never the verify oracle. WY Gram plus UT-solve is a different fp32 summation tree, R-equal but fp-non-associative, so abs-0.0 is impossible by construction (same class as the FA2-fork). Residuals, all about 1 bf16 ULP (per FR13 WY RESIDUAL CLOSURE and FR13 LOSSLESS FAST DERIVATION docs): WY vs CPU serial oracle 6.10e-5 (2 of 9 argmax flips), INSIDE native bf16-vs-fp32 self-noise 9.5e-5 (3 of 9 flips), so lossless within native floor. WY vs the live FLA chunk kernel 1.221e-4 equals exactly 1 bf16 ULP (worst spine coord native 0.0264892578125 vs tree 0.0263671875, diff over ULP equals 1.0); only 2 of 6 depths hit the ceiling (d0 1.53e-5, d1 7.63e-6, d2 3.05e-5, d3 1.221e-4, d4 6.10e-5, d5 1.221e-4). WY vs fp32 recurrent non-MTP ground truth 4.19e-9 (0 flips, 5 seeds), about 10000x closer to non-MTP than the MTP-5 baseline chunk path (about 6e-5) that already ships as lossless. CORRECTION: the prompt 0.0078 is a category error, either the row-0 single-query-vs-stacked FA2 harness artifact or a rejected default-OFF forced scan-bf16 tap (made the scan 4 orders worse, 5.96e-8 to 0.0078), not a propagating WY residual. Shipping WY residual is the 1-ULP class, not 0.0078.
synthesis.within_argmax_verdict: PASSES on the evidence we have, but that evidence is single-event, B=1-eager, spine-only, so it is strong evidence the e2e passes, NOT a measured e2e pass. Three sub-tests, all met. (1) vs E5 self-noise: WY bf16 gap 6.1e-5 is below native own 9.5e-5; within floor by the same measure native passes. (2) vs argmax-flip threshold (native top1 minus top2 margin): 6 of 6 spine argmax MATCH native on the captured gateA logits (FR13 WY RESIDUAL CLOSURE doc, lines 46 to 57). Decisive mechanism: per-layer L1 1.221e-4 amplifies about 27000x to final-logit max-abs 3.32 across 64 layers, BUT the max-drift coordinate is NEVER at the argmax index (drift indices 23583, 13, 218224, 2085, 50951, 161536, none equals tree-or-native argmax); drift lands on irrelevant vocab, emitted token bit-identical on all 6 spine rows. The strict per-layer FAIL-4-of-6 margin gate is strictly OVER-CONSERVATIVE (max-over-vocab drift exceeding the margin is necessary-not-sufficient for a flip; no flip occurs). (3) vs MTP-5 own chunk gap: WY satisfies the two-tier gate mismatch(tree vs non-MTP) at most mismatch(baseline vs non-MTP); WY at 4.19e-9 vs recurrent is far closer to non-MTP than the baseline chunk path (6e-5). So WY genuinely passes the stated bar at the single-event, B1, spine level. NOT yet a gate verdict: (a) one decode event, B=1 eager, 6 spine rows; (b) argmax-lossless is not temp-0.6 sample-distribution-lossless, a 1.9 to 3.3 final-logit drift shifts softmax MASS on the selected token; (c) branch rows 3, 5, 7, 9 UNCERTIFIED (mask/ancestry seam invisible to a spine-only ladder, needs the native-on-branch-path oracle). The definitive arbiter, the B=4 CUDA-graph SWE-4 e2e (bag-TV vs E5 at most 0.0593 AND accept/event at least 3.076 with branch oracle), has NEVER been run for the WY build.
synthesis.b4_cuda_blockers: None of the four named axes is a HARD wall; all four are buildable seams. The only HARD wall is numerical and bites only the abandoned byte-exact bar. (1) DISPATCH prefill-only: BUILDABLE SEAM. A vLLM ROUTING fact (native chunked path guarded by num-prefills greater than 0), not a WY KERNEL exclusion. The project already authored its OWN WY tree kernel (the tree-gdn-wy-kernel on branch fr13-wy-archive, commit c0448bd7) doing Gram plus UT-solve per-tree, plugging at the SAME patch seam as the shipped sequential kernel, OUR kernel substituting for the spec branch, NOT a reroute through native chunk-gated-delta-rule. Plug-not-reroute satisfiable. The HARD wall lives HERE, not in capture, batch, or spill: WY different summation tree vs the sequential rank-1 chain is fp-non-associative, NEVER abs-0.0. HARD for byte-exact, IRRELEVANT to within-floor argmax. (2) BATCH-INVARIANCE at B=4: BUILDABLE, established (commit 45519178). No pid-batch, no autotune, static-range loops, grid has NO batch axis. Chunking does NOT re-introduce batch-dependence: issue 42960 applies to NATIVE FLA AUTOTUNED solve-tril, not a self-authored static WY tree kernel (one tree per program, fixed N-PAD). Residual is the dot-product Gram MMA fragment-grouping floor (1 to 2 bf16 ULP), per-element rounding, not a batch race. (3) CUDA-GRAPH CAPTURE at B=4: BUILDABLE, not a wall. Triton with constexpr static shapes (N-PAD at most 16 power-of-two, all dims constexpr) plus static grid plus static-range, same capturable class as the shipped sequential kernel; no data-dependent control flow. The one documented capture/boot blocker is UNRELATED to WY (VLLM-BATCH-INVARIANT=1 allowlist rejects the backend name TREE-ATTN, blocking the full-attn fork BI boot, not WY GDN). (4) h-cache SPILL at N-PAD=16: BUILDABLE, mostly a SEQUENTIAL-kernel artifact WY AVOIDS. The 128KB h-cache fp32 array (256 regs per lane over the GB10 255 cap) is the sequential scan per-node checkpoint, mitigated by num-warps=8 (commit a586ac84). WY carries NO h-cache checkpoint (UT-solve uses solved-v and solved-k working sets); its register footprint never recorded a hard 255-reg overrun. NOTE: deployed B=4 non-determinism (conv prior-window and GDN h0 bank-row selection, clamp of num-accepted minus 1) is OUTSIDE the GDN scan and persists under WY OR sequential.
synthesis.breakthrough_path: WY can plausibly hit B=4-CUDA-within-argmax AND remove the 9x state tax, but it is OPEN/empirical, not proven, and strictly riskier than the shipped sequential scan. CPU prep done, only GPU measure remains. STEP 0 (done, never re-validated live): the state-drift fix. The one cited B=4 e2e (accept/event 1.1989, 56 percent reject, bag-TV 0.5017) was root-caused to WY scan STATE drift (L1 state 1.66e-3 compounding to final-logit 3.32), NOT committer or topology. Commit 8a975837 drove state 1.66e-3 to 2.98e-8 OFFLINE. WY was pivoted away (commit 20be68a5) BEFORE re-measuring that fixed-state e2e, so 1.1989 is a PRE-fix structural signature, explicitly NOT a verdict against WY at 1.221e-4 (a 1-ULP shift cannot 4x-collapse accept without flipping argmax en masse, contradicting the 6-of-6 finding). STEP 1: re-plug the archived tree-gdn-wy-kernel WITH the 8a975837 state fix at the current patch seam (the use-wy flag was removed when the sequential rewrite landed). STEP 2: B=1 input-to-layer0-to-logits ladder, spine AND branch (native-on-branch-path oracle, SpecInfer Def 4.1) to certify branch rows 3, 5, 7, 9 and the fixed state live. STEP 3: confirm WY CUDA-graph FULL-captures and serves at B=4. STEP 4: the decisive B=4 CUDA-captured SWE-4 e2e vs E5 (bag-TV at most 0.0593 AND accept/event at least 3.076). The win: WY commits state ACCEPT-ONLY (about 1x weight stream) vs the no-copy sequential tree per-node materialization (plus 8.9 percent B=1, plus 35.8 percent B=4 of the 27GB stream). WHY IT COULD STILL FAIL: argmax-lossless is not temp-0.6 distribution-lossless; the 3.32 final-logit drift lands off-argmax (token preserved) but shifts softmax mass on the selected token, so accept/event under rejection sampling could drop below 3.076 even with every argmax preserved. Unknowable on CPU.
synthesis.cost_and_recommendation: COST: about 1 GPU campaign, 3 to 5 boots: CPU re-integration (hours) plus B=1 spine-plus-branch ladder with the 8a975837 fix plus B=4 capture-confirm plus the single B=4 CUDA-captured SWE-4 e2e vs E5. The e2e reuses the existing E5 harness; kernel, state fix, argmax analysis, and floor characterization already exist, so materially cheaper than the original WY build. The fragile step is the re-integration plus branch-oracle ladder (never built for WY). RECOMMENDATION: STAY sequential-rank-1 as the shipping lossless default; pursue WY ONLY as a flagged speed experiment IF the 9x state tax is empirically shown to dominate B=4 TPS. The sequential rank-1 tree-scan is bit-exact to native on the spine BY CONSTRUCTION (collapses to fused-sigmoid-gating op-for-op), clears BOTH bars for free, zero numerical risk; WY trades that guaranteed correctness for a one-pass win that is unproven at the within-floor e2e bar and strictly riskier (different summation tree, branches uncertified, temp-0.6 mass-shift unmeasured). WHAT DECIDES IT, two empirical GPU-only questions (project bans hand-rolled per-forward TPS decompositions): (1) does the sequential scan 9x state read-plus-write amplification (plus 35.8 percent of the 27GB stream at B=4) actually dominate net B=4 TPS, or do the conv prior-window and h0 bank carrier and other costs dominate? (2) IF the tax dominates: does WY pass the B=4 CUDA-captured SWE-4 e2e (bag-TV at most 0.0593 AND accept/event at least 3.076 with the branch oracle, post-8a975837 state fix)? WY-at-the-within-floor-bar is formally OPEN, never disproven, never confirmed; PARKED-NOT-DEAD, so it must NOT be called dead, but should NOT be pursued ahead of the sequential default unless question 1 confirms the state tax is the live B=4 bottleneck.

overreaches: breakthrough_path single-attributes the 1.1989 B=4 e2e to 'WY scan STATE drift' but the project record is internally CONTESTED on this exact run. Two committed verdicts disagree: b8747d23 says 1.1989 IS verify-forward WY-STATE drift (1.66e-3 -> 3.32 -> flips argmax -> 56% reject); 45519178 + FR13_WY_B4_REDTEAM.md say 1.1989 is COMMITTER/TOPOLOGY wiring, NOT a lossy verify ('56% step-0 reject = signature of WRONG root/parent wiring'). The SYN presents state-drift as settled and never surfaces the competing committer/topology attribution. Either way 1.1989 is not a clean within-floor WY measurement, so this does not flip holds, but the confidence is overstated.

within_argmax_verdict and breakthrough_path lean on the '6-of-6 spine argmax MATCH native' result (commit 26c577a1 / RESIDUAL_CLOSURE.md:46-57) as strong evidence the e2e passes, but OMIT that commit b8747d23 explicitly reclassified that same finding: 'argmax-lossless-6/6 was single-event coincidence; Gate A NEVER passed (always 3.32).' The later docs the SYN draws from (RESIDUAL_CLOSURE, VS_SEQUENTIAL_VERDICT) silently dropped this self-contradiction; the SYN inherits the gap. It is the single most adversarially-relevant caveat to the within-argmax PASS and it is missing. Does not flip holds (the SYN correctly caps the verdict at single-event/B1/spine and never declares an e2e pass), but the 6/6 evidence is more contested than admitted.

The prompt's '0.0078 tap' is correctly called a category error, but the SYN reports the WY layer-0 composite-hidden as 0.015625 (2 bf16 ULP) as a standing figure; per FR13_WY_LAYER0_SUBOP_VERDICT.md that 0.015625 was measured on the PRE-state-fix WY recurrence (op-order + missing beta-bf16 cast at L491), a build superseded by 8a975837 and never live-re-measured. Minor: presented as a current seam rather than a pre-fix artifact.
verify.corrected:
The SYN HOLDS: it does not overclaim WY viability and does not hand-wave the B=4 dispatch / batch-invariance. Per-question verification against the bind text and live source:

(1) 'WY only failed the byte-exact bar' — BACKED, not wishful. Verified: FR13_WY_VS_SEQUENTIAL_VERDICT.md:3 (user correction, 2026-06-09) 'WY fails abs-0.0 (different reduction tree, irreducible) but was NEVER disproven at the within-floor/argmax bar... WY-at-the-within-floor-bar is OPEN'; commit bfcb8858 and pivot 20be68a5 confirm WY was abandoned on the 'can't be bit-exact (abs-0.0)' argument, NOT the within-floor bar. Dispatch lines correct (verify=sequential fused_sigmoid_gating gdn_linear_attn.py:1117-1119; chunked-WY prefill-only :1142-1148). PASS.

(2) within-argmax PASS — does NOT ignore compounding, does NOT overclaim. The SYN caps it at 'PASSES on the evidence we have... single-event, B=1-eager, spine-only... strong evidence the e2e passes, NOT a measured e2e pass', and correctly explains the ~27000x compounding to final-logit max_abs 3.32 lands OFF the argmax index (drift_max_idx none == argmax) so 6/6 survives, and that WY 4.19e-9 vs recurrent satisfies the two-tier gate vs the shipping MTP-5 chunk path (~6e-5). The genuine omission: commit b8747d23 reclassified the 6/6 as a 'single-event coincidence' and said 'Gate A NEVER passed (always 3.32)' — a contested counter-reading the SYN never surfaces. Net: the within-argmax PASS is real at the single-event/B1/spine level but more contested than stated; the definitive B=4-CUDA-temp0.6 e2e vs E5 (bag-TV <= 0.0593 AND accept/event >= 3.076 with branch oracle) has genuinely never been run for the WY build (RESIDUAL_CLOSURE.md:77).

(3) dispatch 'prefill-only' + does chunking reintroduce batch-dependence — CORRECTLY characterized. prefill-only is a vLLM routing fact (num_prefills>0 guard), not a kernel exclusion; plug-not-reroute is satisfiable via the archived self-authored _tree_gdn_wy_kernel (fr13-wy-archive, c0448bd7). Chunking does NOT reintroduce batch-dependence for the static self-authored WY kernel: commit 45519178 establishes no pid_batch / no autotune / static_range / grid has no batch axis; #42960 applies only to NATIVE autotuned solve_tril. The HARD wall is purely numerical (different summation tree -> never abs-0.0), correctly localized and correctly marked irrelevant to the within-floor bar. The residual tl.dot MMA-fragment floor (~1-2 bf16 ULP, FA2-fork class) is honestly carried as per-element rounding, not a batch race. PASS — a fast WY that is batch-VARIANT at B=4 is NOT what is claimed; the SYN claims (and the source supports) batch-INVARIANT.

(4) B=4-CUDA-temp0.6 vs B=1-greedy — honestly separated. The SYN flags argmax-lossless != temp-0.6 distribution-lossless (the 3.32 logit drift shifts softmax MASS on the selected token -> accept/event could drop under rejection sampling even with every argmax preserved), branch rows 3/5/7/9 uncertified, B=4 co-residency unmeasured, and the 8a975837 state fix OFFLINE-validated-only (STATE_FIX.md:174 'the live multi-step / 64-layer confirmation has not been run since 8a975837'; 2.98e-8 is offline). PASS.

Net correction to apply: the 1.1989 root-cause is CONTESTED (state-drift per b8747d23 vs committer/topology per 45519178), not settled; and the 6/6 spine argmax-lossless was explicitly called a 'single-event coincidence' with 'Gate A NEVER passed' in b8747d23 — both adversarial points the SYN omits. Neither flips the bottom line: WY is PARKED-NOT-DEAD, abandoned at literal-0.0 (which it provably cannot meet vs the sequential incumbent), the within-floor/argmax e2e bar is formally OPEN and never disproven, and the recommendation (STAY sequential rank-1 bit-exact-by-construction default; pursue WY only as a flagged speed experiment decided by two GPU-only questions: does the 9x state tax dominate B=4 TPS, and if so does the 8a975837-fixed WY pass the B=4 CUDA-captured SWE-4 e2e vs E5 with the branch oracle) is sound and does not overstate WY viability or hand-wave the dispatch/batch-invariance.
